messages:
dispatch-bot: INCIDENT P0 detected for tenant=sylph (enterprise, VPC) — spike in 5xx from ap-south-1 -> routing anomaly suspected. Paging oncall.

marta: on it. seeing 5xx increase ~12:04 UTC, error surface is 503s from inference-gateway. adding logs.

ashok: confirmed. tail from gw-prod-ap-south logs: ```
2026-03-15T12:03:58Z svc=gateway status=503 model=redwood-large seq=length=512 route=prod-ap-south
2026-03-15T12:04:01Z svc=gateway status=503 tenant=sylph pool=dedicated-ap-south-1
```

kevin: looks like a warm pool pressure + long queueing. Sylph is on a dedicated pool in ap-south-1 but capacity is near saturation. CPU on gpus showing high mem spikes, KV cache thrash.

marta: priority = isolate tenant to stop noisy neighbor impact on other tenants. plan: cordon sylph from shared ingress, shift traffic to warm fallback in ap-south-2 (warm standby preprovisioned) using weighted DNS. notify customer ops.

elia: pinging Sylph account team (elia -> sylph-ops@customer). prepping customer-facing note: "We're seeing elevated errors for requests routed to ap-south-1; working on failover to standby region. No data loss; transient request retries may be required." will post in 10m.

ashok: executing staged traffic cordon now. steps: 1) attach route tag cordon=sylph on gateways in ap-south-1 2) update smart-router policy to route sylph to ap-south-2 with weight 90% 3) increase warm pool capacity in ap-south-2 by +2 nodes.

kevin: running infra ops commands now: ```bash
# tag affected gateways
redwoodctl gateway tag --region ap-south-1 --filter tenant:sylph cordon=true
# update routing policy
redwoodctl routing set-weight --tenant sylph --from ap-south-1=10 --to ap-south-2=90
# scale dedicated pool in ap-south-2
redwoodctl pool scale --pool sylph-dedicated-ap-south-2 --replicas +2
```

eng-sre-bot: Scaling job accepted: job_id=scale-7723, estimated time 2m 30s.

marta: quick health check after weight shift? ashok can you watch 5xx and p95 latency for sylph?

ashok: metrics: within 60s p95 down from 1.2s -> 450ms, 5xx rate dropping from 8% -> 1.5% on shifted traffic. still a handful of errors on ap-south-1 path.

kevin: pool scaled, new nodes attached and warmed caches (kv prefill started). logs show reduced OOMs.

elia: customer note posted to their channel + status page. cc @sylph-ops. "We have initiated a regional diversion to our standby capacity; engineers are monitoring. We'll update in 15m or on stabilization."

marta: starting tenant isolation pass — removing sylph from shared LB health sets to ensure no residual routing. commands: ```
redwoodctl lb detach --name shared-ingress-ap-south --tenant sylph
```

kevin: detached. verifying no new session cookies being issued to ap-south-1.

ashok: found a model-serving process crash pattern on older quantized runtime, speculatively triggered by a recent kernel rollover. filing follow-up with runtime team. for now mitigation succeeded.

marta: paging runtime team for root cause: @sophie can you pick up runtime RCA?

sophie: oncall runtime, ack. will grab logs & core dumps from pool nodes in ap-south-1 and ap-south-2 and compare kernel versions + libcu versions. starting now.

eng-sre-bot: incident updated: severity=P1 -> P0 (still page). incident channel pinned: #incidents-2864459000.

kevin: customer traffic steady on ap-south-2, error rate stable ~0.8%. rolling weight up to 95% in 5m to drain ap-south-1.

marta: prepping DNS plan in case weighted routing insufficient: TTL bump to 60s then CNAME swap + flush for sylph-custom.example.net. we prefer weighted router but have DNS carve-out if direct region routing needed.

elia: customer ops: asking if we need to open a private syscall for their compliance team. they asked about preservation of session affinity — confirming affinity preserved for new region.

ashok: affinity maintained via session cookie rewrite at router layer. older sessions hitting ap-south-1 may 503 until drained. we can force drain by setting weight ap-south-1=0 but will cause immediate cutover. propose a 95->5->0 ramp, waiting 3m between steps.

marta: agree. execute ramp. kevin perform weight 95->5 now.

kevin: routing weight set: ap-south-1=5 ap-south-2=95.

ashok: monitoring... 5xx on ap-south-1 reduced to noise floor. ap-south-2 stable.

dispatch-bot: NOTE: paging escalation to engineering director (marta) at 12:18 UTC for cross-team coordination.

marta: starting handoff notes for next oncall in 20m. key items: Sylph incident -> isolated to standby ap-south-2, dedicated pool scaled, runtime team investigating crashes on quantized runtime in ap-south-1, customer notified. still monitoring.

elia: drafted customer follow-up with tentative ETA 60-90m for full stabilization. will update status page with timeline.

sophie: collected cores, preliminary finding: nodes running kernel-5.16-rc had a micro-regression with cuda-driver 535.x in our optimized runtime path. reproducing in staging now. filing BUG-9874.

marta: ok. mitigation complete = traffic drained from ap-south-1, setting ap-south-1 weight to 0 to finish drain.

kevin: set weight ap-south-1=0 ap-south-2=100. detached all LB instances for sylph in ap-south-1.

ashok: post-cut checks: overall cluster p95 430ms, 5xx <0.3% for sylph, no impact seen for other tenants. marking customer impact: partial degraded for 55m window while failover completed.

marta: declaring status: mitigation successful. creating follow-up ticket for dedicated runtime fix + backfill nodes in ap-south-1. handoff to oncall @kevin until 13:00 UTC. please watch for regression and customer replies.

dispatch-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> monitoring. incident closed at 12:44 UTC for paging purposes; follow-up tasks created: BUG-9874, TASK-2026, RFC for regional warm pool health checks.

kevin: ack handoff. will keep eyes on metrics for next hour.

elia: final customer note posted: "We routed traffic to our standby region and stabilized your service. Root cause under investigation; will share technical RCA and timeline for fix." :white_check_mark:"
